description: HTML source code for a web-based database viewer interface, including styling, layout, and client-side JavaScript for fetching and displaying database, table, and data information dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets view state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for the data table based on fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates individual cell HTML, handles object and long content expansion.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
